digest_definition: SHA256(json.dumps([[row['path'], row['sha256'], row['lines']] for row in files], separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8'))
ordering: files array, sorted by source Path during freeze; absolute line counts, raw-byte file SHA256, repository-relative path
not_equivalent_to: Runner control_hash, which includes an explicitly selected source-binding file and independently needs approval; direct JSON object-row serialization; manifest-file digest.
